_doc: Task 124 §2 — sourced gap-fill for entities whose guard fields the repo datasets do not carry. One record per entity, applied by scripts/build-entity-index.mjs (via src/lib/entityIndexBuild.ts) as the LOWEST-priority enrichment source: a field is only written when the merged record does not already have it. Facts were read from the Elden Ring wikis; `source` is the page each record was taken from. Do not add a record without a source URL.

records.name: Knight Leontiel
records.location: Wailing Dunes, Caelid — north of the Starscourge Radahn arena toward the War-Dead Catacombs.
records.strategy: Leontiel is a mid-to-late-game melee invader with high poise from her plate set. She chains delayed greatsword swings into her unique skill, Muleta: in the muleta stance she flourishes the red cloth, gains evasion on the follow-up, then answers with either a slashing light finish or a thrusting heavy finish. Do not panic-roll into the flourish or chase the sidestep; break her poise with jump attacks, charged heavies or stance skills.
records.note: Neither wiki lists damage negation/absorptions for Leontiel; the standard NPC-invader profile used by the repo's enemy-combat dump is applied.

records.name: Millicent's Sisters
records.location: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree — the sisters ambush during Millicent's questline's endgame.
records.strategy: A collective of four NPC invaders: Polyanna (Blade of Calling), Maureen (Treespear), Amy (twin Flowing Curved Swords) and Mary (Halo Scythe, inflicts Hemorrhage). All cast Pest Threads and are immune to Scarlet Rot but weak to Poison, Hemorrhage and Fire, with low poise. Split their aggro immediately; Millicent can only weather one or two sisters, so use Shabriri's Woe and a shield to draw them.
records.note: Neither wiki lists damage negation/absorptions for the sisters; the standard NPC-invader profile is applied. HP listed per member.
